conbody.p: The system will be disarmed when:

section.title: Smart key

li.p: The door unlock button is pressed.
The button of the front outside door is pressed while carrying the smart key.

section.p: After the doors are unlocked, the hazard warning lights will blink twice to indicate that the system is disarmed.
After pressing the unlock button, if any door (or tailgate) is not opened within 30 seconds, the system will be rearmed.
